commitments.commitment: Two-sided deterministic Desk setup contract with true SHORT-side entry/cover-target/invalidation/action/R-multiple semantics
commitments.sourceFinding: Current renderer computePlan derives BEARISH direction from a low directional score but always constructs long-oriented geometry: target above price/entry and invalidation below entry. actionState is also long-oriented. Therefore the visible Entry Zone / Trim-Target / Invalidation / Setup Score strip is not a true mirrored SHORT plan today.

requiredContract.side: LONG | SHORT | NO_SETUP/WAIT; side is explicit and not inferred from UI color
requiredContract.setupQuality: 0..100 quality/confidence-style setup score independent of bullish/bearish direction; never presented as win probability
requiredContract.directionalEvidence: separate signed/banded directional evidence so a strong SHORT setup may still have a high setup-quality score
requiredContract.longGeometry: entry zone; trim/target above entry; invalidation below entry; positive R computed in long direction
requiredContract.shortGeometry: short-entry zone; cover/target below entry; invalidation above entry; positive R computed in short direction
requiredContract.actionState: IN_ENTRY_ZONE / APPROACHING / EXTENDED / TARGET_REVIEW / INVALIDATED comparisons reverse correctly for SHORT
requiredContract.labels: SHORT may use Cover / Target rather than long-only Trim / Target wording where clearer; preserve existing Desk look-and-feel
consumers: Long-Term horizon where a two-sided thesis is evidence-eligible
requiredContract.truthfulness: Do not force a SHORT setup solely because directional evidence is bearish; NO_SETUP/WAIT remains valid when quality/readiness is insufficient.
requiredContract.executionBoundary: Decision support only; No Execution remains permanent.

evidenceRequired: unit/contract tests for mirrored long/short geometry and R-multiple
bearish strong-setup regression proving high setup quality is possible without bullish encoding
action-state boundary tests for both sides
no change to approved Desk visual language except truthful side-aware labels/content
